title: Shattered Prism Sorceress
description: A tall, elegant female figure stands with her back to the viewer in the center of a surreal, melting landscape. She wears a long, flowing iridescent gown with vertical rainbow stripes, and a tall, sharp, translucent crystal spire emerges from her head, shattering the sky into jagged glass-like fragments that float around her.
prompt: A mystical female figure seen from behind, standing in a reflective liquid landscape. She wears a long striped iridescent gown that melts into the ground. A massive translucent crystal spire protrudes from her head, cracking the sky into floating glass shards. Colorful aurora-like light swirls in the background, with dripping liquid effects and reflective surfaces, surreal dreamlike atmosphere.
